minecraft:emitter_initialization.per_update_expression: v.tod = q.time_of_day > 0.0 ? q.time_of_day : (v.tod_start ?? 0.0); v.sun_angle = (v.tod - 0.25) * 360.0; v.sun_x = math.cos(v.sun_angle); v.sun_y = math.sin(v.sun_angle); v.night = v.sun_y < 0.0 ? 1.0 : 0.0; v.light_x = v.night ? -v.sun_x : v.sun_x; v.light_y = v.night ? -v.sun_y : v.sun_y; v.high = math.clamp((v.light_y - 0.2) * 1.6, 0.0, 1.0); v.wet = math.lerp(v.wet ?? 0.0, q.is_in_water_or_rain, 0.03); v.strength = math.clamp(v.light_y * 5.0, 0.0, 1.0) * (1.0 - 0.5 * v.high) * (1.0 - v.wet) * (v.night ? 0.35 * q.moon_brightness : 1.0);

minecraft:particle_initialization.per_update_expression: v.p_ring = 6.0 + 16.0 * v.particle_random_1; v.p_turn = 360.0 * v.particle_random_2; v.p_k = v.p_ring * math.sin(v.p_turn); v.p_k = (v.p_k * v.light_x < -1.0) ? -v.p_k : v.p_k; v.p_side = v.p_ring * math.cos(v.p_turn); v.p_along = -6.0 + 20.0 * v.particle_random_3; v.p_len = 16.0 + 14.0 * v.particle_random_4; v.p_wide = 0.6 + 1.2 * (v.particle_random_1 * 7.0 - math.floor(v.particle_random_1 * 7.0)); v.p_bright = 0.55 + 0.45 * (v.particle_random_2 * 5.0 - math.floor(v.particle_random_2 * 5.0));
